text: {"lessons":["Short-term gains and losses are noisy; compare long-run returns with a market benchmark before judging whether my trading adds value.","Selling Stock E at a steep loss and later buying it back higher shows why I need a consistent, evidence-based sell and re-entry plan—not decisions driven by loss aversion or price swings.","When the account turns down, reassess portfolio risk and each holding against clear criteria; avoid both blindly holding and impulsively trading, while keeping position sizes and cash within a deliberate plan."]}
